id: \rThat shop looks shady to me.\nWhat do you think?
en: \rThat shop looks shady to me.\nWhat do you think?
it: \rQuel negozio mi sembra losco.\nTu che ne pensi?

id: \bBetter hope you don't meet me in battle. You'll lose before you know what happened.
en: \bBetter hope you don't meet me in battle. You'll lose before you know what happened.
it: \bSpera di non incontrarmi in lotta. Perderai prima di capire cos'è successo.

id: \bBrock: I expected you would be here sooner or later.
en: \bBrock: I expected you would be here sooner or later.
it: \bBrock: Immaginavo che prima o poi saresti venuto qui.

id: \bI know you're busy preparing for the league, but I think a battle might help you out.
en: \bI know you're busy preparing for the league, but I think a battle might help you out.
it: \bSo che sei impegnato a prepararti per la Lega, ma penso che una lotta potrebbe aiutarti.

id: \bBrock: Great battle \PN! If you want I can groom one of your Pokémon. It may help it in battle.
en: \bBrock: Great battle \PN! If you want I can groom one of your Pokémon. It may help it in battle.
it: \bBrock: Gran bella lotta, \PN! Se vuoi, posso curare l'aspetto di uno dei tuoi Pokémon. Potrebbe aiutarlo in lotta.

id: \bBrock: Which Pokémon do you want me to groom?
en: \bBrock: Which Pokémon do you want me to groom?
it: \bBrock: A quale Pokémon vuoi che faccia la toelettatura?

id: \bBrock: Oh, okay then.
en: \bBrock: Oh, okay then.

id: \bBrock: There! \v[2] looks a lot better now!
en: \bBrock: There! \v[2] looks a lot better now!

en: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?

en: \rI didn't get enough badges, but I still love watching.

id: \rJessie: How can we help you?
en: \rJessie: How can we help you?

id: \rI need to get in some last minute training.
en: \rI need to get in some last minute training.
it: \rDevo fare un ultimo allenamento dell'ultimo minuto.

id: \bBrock: You're done with the Sinnoh League now. Why don't you head home. Your family will want to hear how you did.
en: \bBrock: You're done with the Sinnoh League now.  Why don't you head home. Your family will want to hear how you did.
it: \bBrock: Ora hai finito con la Lega di Sinnoh.  Perché non torni a casa? La tua famiglia vorrà sapere com'è andata.

id: \bBrock: If you want I can groom one of your Pokémon. It may help it in battle.
en: \bBrock: If you want I can groom one of your Pokémon. It may help it in battle.
it: \bBrock: Se vuoi, posso fare la toelettatura a uno dei tuoi Pokémon. Potrebbe aiutarlo in lotta.
